title: 2013 AMC 10A 9
statement: In a recent basketball game, Shenille attempted only three-point shots and two-point shots. She was successful on \(20\%\) of her three-point shots and \(30\%\) of her two-point shots. Shenille attempted \(30\) shots. How many points did she score?

solutions.text:
Let \(x\) be the number of two-point shots and \(y\) be the number of three-point shots.

Then, Shenille makes \(0.3x\) two-point shots and \(0.2y\) three-point shots, for a total score of \[ 2 \cdot 0.3x + 3 \cdot 0.2y = 0.6x + 0.6y. \]

We know that \[ x + y = 30 \]\[ 0.6(x + y) = 18. \]

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Let \(x\) and \(y\) be the numbers of two-point and three-point attempts
Compare the points earned per attempted shot type after applying the success percentages
